inputs.summary: The owner selected terminal-only filtering and retained superseded records.
The trial checked archived and superseded visibility.

record.position: The review page and CLI list, document, and search reads omit archived Requirements, Rules, Questions, and Topics and abandoned Resolutions by default. API callers select this behavior with `exclude_terminal`. Superseded records stay visible.
record.rationale: Hiding all inactive records lost because superseded records remain useful context. Showing terminal records by default lost because archived and abandoned work distracts from current review.
record.title: Hide terminal records from routine review
